title: The corner, iv
logline: Thursday, week three. The night before the Grunion Run: lanterns carried down for setup. In the background of panel one: Wagner's shelves being carried out into a truck. In panel four: the truck gone, the window dark. The strip glances, and doesn't.

panels.composition: Main street, dusk. GULLY with a box of lanterns. WOOD. BARNABY. Behind them: men carrying steel shelving out of Wagner's into a truck.

balloons.text: Twelve lanterns. Uncle's. Been in the shack since '85.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man carrying a box of lanterns down a street at dusk with a thin man and an old dog, men loading steel shelving from a hardware store into a truck behind them

panels.composition: The lanterns, close. Gully lighting one. The truck in the background, half loaded.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man lighting an old lantern with a half-loaded truck in the background

panels.composition: Wood and the dog. The dog looking at the truck. Wood looking at the lantern.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man looking at a lantern while an old dog beside him looks at a truck across the street, no words
image.notes: The dog looks. The strip's glance is his.

panels.composition: The beach road. Twelve lanterns going down it. Behind, at the corner: the truck gone, Wagner's window dark. Unremarked.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The dog glances at the truck. The strip is about lanterns.
